note: Empty by design for 1.3.1: nothing from 1.3.0 was removed. 1.3.1 is a strict superset in framework content; it re-issues the release with personal and host-specific data removed (copyright holder, example actor names, a build-host path) and the repository relicensed Apache-2.0.
purpose: Every semantic item present in a predecessor release and absent here must be listed, with a reason. tools/check_no_loss.py treats an unlisted removal as a hard failure. This is the control that stops a verifier being made green by deleting whatever it complained about.
